DOOMSDAY.label: DOOMSDAY / finished self.root v0.1
DOOMSDAY.definition: Finished self.root/Frank v0.1 on the accepted Hostinger target VPS: exact server-binary/state identity, production token-authenticated API, ClayCode-only cognition, state-aware German translation, general-purpose ClayCode runtime, H1/H2/H3 one-module architecture, UnifiedDB, Digital Retina plus adaptive visual learning, proactive/autotelic long-horizon agency, authority-separated open-web ingress, deterministic effect authority, final validated Clay-native model, restart/recovery continuity, all mandatory terminal receipts and zero open P0/P1 or mandatory NOT_RUN/FAIL gates.
DOOMSDAY.forecast_rule: Never store a fixed target date. Recalculate from the current complete v0.1 critical-path table, dynamically renormalized historical earned work, verified stage/workspace progress, measured throughput, current target-VPS/capacity state, APIs/capabilities, verified accelerators/blockers/new dependencies and owner training authorization state every time the resolver runs.

L0_ARCHIVE_ASSIMILATION.label: Level 0 - FRANK Archive Assimilation + Earned-Work Calibration (666)
L0_ARCHIVE_ASSIMILATION.completion_law: Within <=3h active wall-clock, the persistent 666 swarm exhaustively accounts for and evaluates the full frozen Drive clay corpus plus the full frozen Project-Frankenstein Level-0 history/tree scope, including historical Retina learning/pattern/dictionary/familiarity mechanisms relevant to the mandatory v0.1 adaptive visual learner; reconciles both source universes, completes branch feedback and historical earned-work audit, validates the release manifest, reaches exact coverage 100%, then PASS. Sampling is prioritization only, never completion. External connector waiting is reported separately and never hidden by weakening coverage.

BASE_CLAYCODE_RELEASE.label: BASE - ClayCode General-Purpose Compiler/Runtime
BASE_CLAYCODE_RELEASE.completion_law: Freeze existing semantics where adequate; build parser/canonical IR/type-effect checker/compiler/lowering/runtime/FFI/stdlib/toolchain; compile and execute the mandatory general-purpose application proof suite including real HTTP/website and self.root components. The language/runtime must express versioned visual learner state, proactive AgencyState/goals/checkpoints/heartbeat, untrusted-web authority taint, direct-token scoped intent and deterministic effect authority. Semantics may change only for an executable counterexample.

H1_REFERENCE_HARNESS.label: Harness 1 - Live frankv0.1 Reference FRANK + Adaptive Visual Learning
H1_REFERENCE_HARNESS.completion_law: Reference Harness PASS means the exact current frankv0.1 harness is captured as executable baseline with versioned intentional divergences only, including repository-mediated node continuity, UnifiedDB/ClayGraph, world/self/body/goal state, tools/effects/recovery/receipts, mandatory multimodal/adaptive visual overlays and longitudinal pilot telemetry. Material errors must be causal-localized and regressionized.

H2_CLAYCODE_HARNESS.label: Harness 2 - frankv0.1 Reference Semantics Compiled/Executed in ClayCode
H2_CLAYCODE_HARNESS.completion_law: Clay Harness PASS requires differential equivalence to the frozen H1 baseline for authoritative state transitions, node handoff continuity, UnifiedDB/ClayGraph behavior, world/self/body/goal exposure, error replay/repair, tool/effect/recovery receipts, dissolved visual semantics and adaptive visual learner state transitions. If ClayCode cannot express H1 semantics, reopen ClayCode instead of simplifying H1.

H3_ONE_MODULE_FRANK.label: Harness 3 - One-Module/Binary FRANK + Dissolved Retina + Adaptive Visual Learner
H3_ONE_MODULE_FRANK.completion_law: H3 cannot PASS unless dissolved visual perception and the mandatory adaptive Micro Visual Classifier/cyclic learner are integrated into the one-module/binary runtime as far down the stack as feasible, with no unexplained semantic external learner boundary and with last-known-good rollback/recovery.

UDB_UNIFIED_DATABASE.label: Unified Database + Adaptive Visual Learner Persistence
UDB_UNIFIED_DATABASE.completion_law: UnifiedDB PASS must persist/recover classifier/prototype version identity, trusted-example lineage/tier, calibration/open-set metadata, feature-backbone compatibility, rollback/rebuild state and links to visual evidence without conflating learned familiarity with sensor truth.

DATA_LORA_TRAINING_DATA.label: Final Clay 0.1 Training + Held-Out Data incl. Adaptive Visual State Interface
DATA_LORA_TRAINING_DATA.purpose: Build and freeze final training and held-out corpus only. Include the model-facing familiarity/known/unknown/conflict visual Assembly/schema required by v0.1 while keeping online personal Micro Visual Classifier data out of final model training unless separately admitted by provenance/policy. Do not start paid/final training automatically.

WAIT.label: WAIT - Owner Training Decision
WAIT.meaning: After training-data artifacts are frozen, stop and wait for explicit project-owner authorization. DOOMSDAY forecasting may continue conditionally, but execution of final paid training does not start automatically.

current_stage_goal: Finish ClayCode BASE as the executable general-purpose language/runtime foundation for finished self.root v0.1, including proactive agency, web-ingress authority separation, deterministic effect semantics and adaptive visual state expressibility; preserve frozen semantics unless an executable counterexample requires amendment.

progress_semantics.formula: 100 * completed_weight / total_weight unless a stage declares a stricter exact progress contract
progress_semantics.rule: CURRENT MILESTONE awards progress only from completed local gate weight. DOOMSDAY is separately computed against the complete finished-v0.1 critical path plus dynamically renormalized evidence-mapped historical earned work.

autonomous_progression_rule: On exact 666 while Level 0 is open, join/resume the persistent exhaustive Level-0 swarm campaign. After Level-0 PASS, exact 666 switches to one seeded high-value diverse research field per invocation and feeds evidence-preserving deltas into the mesh.
global_training_rule: No paid or final model training is authorized by program progression alone. The mandatory Micro Visual Classifier may perform bounded local autonomous cyclic updates because those are runtime perception, not final paid model training. After DATA_LORA_TRAINING_DATA completes, transition to WAIT and require explicit owner authorization before final model training. DOOMSDAY forecasting remains conditional on immediate authorization when the data gate is ready until authorization exists.
